# shanghai-restaurant.com
Expert-curated guide to the finest Shanghai restaurants worldwide. From legendary xiaolongbao shops to Michelin-starred fine dining, discover authentic Shanghainese cuisine.

## Key Pages
- [Best Shanghai Restaurants](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/best-shanghai-restaurants/): Our ranked guide to the top 15 Shanghai restaurants.
- [Shanghai Cuisine Guide](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-cuisine-guide/): Complete guide to Shanghai cuisine with 20 must-try dishes.
- [Shanghai Restaurant Menu](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-restaurant-menu/): What to expect on a Shanghai restaurant menu.
- [Blog](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/blog/): Shanghai restaurant stories, guides, and food culture deep dives.
- [Xiaolongbao Guide](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/xiaolongbao/): The ultimate Shanghai soup dumpling guide.
- [Hairy Crab Guide](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/hairy-crab/): Everything about Shanghai's most anticipated food event.
- [NYC Shanghai Restaurants](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-restaurant-nyc/)
- [LA Shanghai Restaurants](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-restaurant-los-angeles/)
- [London Shanghai Restaurants](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-restaurant-london/)
- [Sydney Shanghai Restaurants](https://shanghai-restaurant.com/shanghai-restaurant-sydney/)

## About
We're a curated guide to Shanghai cuisine and restaurants worldwide. Our team researches, visits, and reviews the best Shanghai restaurants to help you find authentic Shanghainese food wherever you are.
